audit.whatIsWrong: win[] and phases[].side contradicted the whys at levels 3, 4-5, first item and two items.
audit.why: Darius's Apprehend-into-Decimate all-in beats Gwen until she has Hallowed Mist and Needlework; from 6 to first item it is genuinely even; at two items his stacked HP is fuel for %-max-HP Snip Snip! and A Thousand Cuts, which the prose already states.
audit.corrected: Darius / Darius / Darius / Skill / Skill / Skill / Gwen.
sources: existing whys[2], whys[3], whys[5], whys[6] prose

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Every window Apprehend is on cooldown is your only safe time to farm' with no cooldown given.
audit.why: Apprehend is 26/23.5/21/18.5/16 - the longest cooldown in his kit by far, and the only reason Gwen can farm at all early. Decimate is 9/8/7/6/5, Crippling Strike 5s and Noxian Guillotine 120/100/80. Naming 26s turns the page's vaguest instruction into a usable clock.
audit.corrected: early, whys[2], spikes[0].text and wants.you[0] now name the 26s Apprehend window; late names the 120s Guillotine.

audit.whatIsWrong: Crippling Strike's auto-attack reset is never identified as a tell, and Decimate's self-heal is mentioned once without an answer.
audit.why: Crippling Strike carries the autoReset flag, so the attack wind-up rather than the ability cast is the moment the slow lands and the combo commits - that is when Hallowed Mist has to already be down. Decimate carries the heal flag, so his outer-blade poke is also his sustain, which is what makes the extended trade he wants survivable for him.
audit.corrected: mid names the Crippling Strike reset as the mist cue; late and whys[6] tie Grievous Wounds to Decimate's healing.

audit.why: Decimate heals him off every champion caught by the outer blade, so the long fight Gwen is told to force is exactly the fight Grievous Wounds decides.
audit.corrected: late and whys[6] now name it.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are his. Darius out-stats you flat — Apprehend yanks you in, the outer blade of Decimate carves a chunk while it heals him off you, and Hemorrhage bleeds keep ticking while your cone Q is still clunky and you have no mist or E dash to escape. Do not try to trade through this; last-hit with the outer snips of Snip Snip! and respect the all-in range of his pull. Every window Apprehend is on cooldown is your only safe time to farm or step up.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are his. Darius out-stats you flat — Apprehend yanks you in, the outer blade of Decimate carves a chunk while it heals him off you, and Hemorrhage bleeds keep ticking while your cone Q is still clunky and you have no mist or E dash to escape. Do not trade through this; last-hit with the outer snips of Snip Snip!. Apprehend is 26s at rank 1, so the moment he misses it you have twenty seconds to farm freely — that window is the whole early game.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 stay soft for you, but at 6 it evens out. With Hallowed Mist plus Needlework you can finally answer his commit — bait the Apprehend pull, drop your mist as you land so his Decimate and Crippling Strike follow-up land while you are untargetable, and slow him with R while you snip. The longer the fight runs the more your ability healing and %-max-HP Q swing it. The trap is Noxian Guillotine: if he catches you low, the true-damage execute ignores your sustain entirely, so only commit at healthy HP.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 stay soft for you, but at 6 it evens out. With Hallowed Mist plus Needlework you can finally answer his commit — bait the Apprehend pull, drop your mist as you land so his Decimate and Crippling Strike follow-up land while you are untargetable, and slow him with R while you snip. Crippling Strike is an auto reset, so the wind-up is your mist cue, not the cast. The longer the fight runs the more your healing and %-max-HP Q swing it. The trap is Noxian Guillotine: caught low, its true damage ignores your sustain, so only commit healthy.

edits.before: This flips to you. Two items in, every point of HP Darius stacks is just more fuel for Thousand Cuts and Snip Snip!'s %-max-HP magic — his armor does nothing against it, and his big bar means more healing for you on every ability hit. Fight inside Hallowed Mist so his all-in stalls while you out-grind him, and respect only the Guillotine execute window when you are low. Close the lane on his Apprehend cooldowns and you own every extended brawl from here.
edits.after: This flips to you. Two items in, every point of HP Darius stacks is more fuel for A Thousand Cuts and Snip Snip!'s %-max-HP magic — his armour does nothing against it, and his big bar means more healing for you on every ability hit. Buy Grievous Wounds so Decimate stops refunding him, fight inside Hallowed Mist so his all-in stalls, and respect only the 120s Guillotine when you are low. Close the lane on his 26s Apprehend cooldowns and you own every extended brawl.

notes: Prose here is already second-person and accurate on names; the failure is the chart and the missing numbers. win[] and phases[].side disagreed with the whys at four of seven stages - whys[2] says Darius wins every melee trade at 3 (chart said Skill), whys[3] and whys[5] call 4-5 and first item even (chart said Darius at 4-5 and at first item), whys[6] says Gwen out-trades every extended duel at two items (chart said Darius). Corrected to Darius/Darius/Darius/Skill/Skill/Skill/Gwen. The single most useful number on this page was missing: Apprehend is 26 seconds at rank 1. The page tells you three separate times to farm 'when Apprehend is down' without ever saying that the window is roughly twenty seconds long, which is the difference between a nervous last-hit and a full wave. Also added Crippling Strike as the auto-attack reset tell and Decimate's self-heal as the Grievous Wounds trigger. 'Thousand Cuts' was missing its 'A' in three places.
